faqs.question: Do you treat honeybees in Baldwin?
faqs.answer: No, we do not treat honeybees. If an inspection confirms a colony is honeybees rather than wasps or hornets, we refer the situation to a licensed beekeeper instead of treating it ourselves.

faqs.question: Will the wasps or hornets come back after treatment?
faqs.answer: Nest treatment eliminates the active colony, and sealing every entry point prevents recolonization in that location. Every service includes a service agreement — terms depend on the service and are confirmed on the call.
